title: A container crosses free time and starts accumulating avoidable detention or demurrage charges
job: Move equipment before chargeable free time expires and challenge invalid charges with evidence.
trigger: Container availability/free-time clock starts or an exception blocks pickup/return.
surfaceComplaint: We got charged even though the box was not realistically retrievable.
mechanism: Charge liability depends on time, availability, appointments, releases and return conditions distributed across organizations. Evidence is often assembled only after billing.

existingSpend.amount: FMC reports ~$15.4B collected by nine carriers Apr 2020-Mar 2025

economics.painCostNote: Repeated episodes make this directly monetizable as prevention or recovery.

buyer.wtp: percentage of recovered charges or SaaS

distribution.acquisition: Start as historical recovery audit, then move upstream.

competitors.gap: may not own charge evidence/dispute packet

intervention.notBuildYet: No universal real-time port integration before proving recovery.

experiment.success: recover/prevent >5x fee and find repeatable cause clusters
experiment.kill: evidence usually unavailable or incumbents capture most value

claims.text: FMC reports nine carriers collected roughly US$15.4B in detention and demurrage from Apr 2020 through Mar 2025.
A prevention product should first prove itself as a retrospective recovery audit.
